architecture: Full spatial-temporal physical video stream initialized from first five official Wan blocks, frozen original caption attention, independent C reader, zero-initialized fullwidth output hints to native Wan. No relation-slot pooling, no native FFN rewrite, no conditional/unconditional block difference.

task_reading.BT: direct C only, based on own AT paired16
task_reading.BI: direct and caption-associated C, based on own AI paired16

training_losses: unchanged FM.8/tail.2 + route-source fidelity;128physical/272joint; no new physical label/constraint

differences_from_failed_designs.R20A: A adds per-position language-derived messages directly to the main video state. B first evolves a separate full video grid with pretrained self-attention, frozen caption reads, C reads and FFN; its learned fullwidth hints enter intact main blocks.
differences_from_failed_designs.R19CT/EI: Those pool video into relation slots and alter main FFN activations. B retains every native T/H/W position and original3D RoPE, evolves video states persistently, and leaves main FFN execution intact.
differences_from_failed_designs.R19BI: BI uses B(h+physical)-B(h) differences of video blocks. B has a persistent independent video stream and learned output maps, without subtracting two nonlinear block outputs.
differences_from_failed_designs.R19BT: No learned semantic attention copy or MoE is added. Both original and copied caption Q/K/V/O are frozen; the C reader is separately trainable.
